notes: Background: mid-market CX platform (multimodal chat + agent assist + doc search); high PLG adoption; planning to bake LLM features into product tiering.
Ran hosted API trial for 6 weeks (sandbox + limited prod) — ~1.2M tokens/month on trial credits; traffic concentrated in support-assist flows.
Customer narrative: wants same dev experience in Dedicated as Hosted; must meet p95 latency <250ms for chat, cost target <$0.006/token average over committed capacity.
Quote from CTO: 'We need predictable unit economics — can't have month-to-month token spikes blow up our margins.'
SE feedback: prefers model routing to smaller, cheaper variants for low-criticality flows and larger models for escalation only.
Security: requires SAML SSO, audit logs retention 1 year, KMS integration for key rotation, and optional data residency in us-east-1.
Deployment ask: VPC peering + private egress for Dedicated; tight egress controls for PII-containing transcripts.
POC scope expanded: include rate-limited canary on Dedicated pool and a fall-back policy to Hosted API during capacity drain.
Pricing conversation: evaluating 12-mo vs 24-mo reserved capacity; finance wants scenario analysis for 30%, 60%, 100% load plans.
Notes style: shorthand, action-oriented. Will attach sizing worksheet and trial usage export to Drive link below.
